name: Ion Cutelaba
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Moldovan light heavyweight veteran (20-14 in our data, age 32) known for explosive starts. He was knocked out by Navajo Stirling in R2 in June after a R1 submission of Oumar Sy in March.

how_they_fight.Striking: Explosive and wild; thirteen knockouts in our data, twelve in R1.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Powerful takedowns; five submissions, four in R1.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped eight times in our data, mostly in R1-R2.

patterns: Explosive R1; nearly all finishes in R1
keys_to_beat: Survive his first round, then pressure him

sources.author: Mike Heck
sources.title: UFC Saudi Arabia: Several new bouts added to Israel Adesanya vs. Shara Magomedov fight card
